WITH order_counts AS (
  SELECT a.account_id, COALESCE(COUNT(o.order_id), 0) as order_count
  FROM account a
  LEFT JOIN `order` o ON a.account_id = o.account_id
  GROUP BY a.account_id
),
total_orders AS (
  SELECT SUM(order_count) as total FROM order_counts
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    account_id,
    order_count,
    order_count * 1.0 / (SELECT total FROM total_orders) as share
  FROM order_counts
),
avg_share_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM with_shares
)
SELECT
  SUM(ws.order_count) as total_orders,
  AVG(ws.share) as avg_share,
  AVG(ws.share - asc.avg_share) as avg_above_avg
FROM with_shares ws
CROSS JOIN avg_share_calc asc
WHERE ws.share > asc.avg_share
